title: Coach
refreshRequested: Your coach will update the plan in a few minutes.
contextTitle: What the coach saw on its latest update

notConfigured.title: No AI model is set up for you yet
notConfigured.description: Add your API key or choose a model provider in the coach settings.

notEnabled.title: Get a personal training plan
notEnabled.description: Your coach reads your activities, sleep and notes, and keeps a 14-day plan up to date. Turn it on and add your goals in the coach settings.

pending: Your coach is reviewing your latest data and updating the plan. This page refreshes on its own.
failed: The last update failed. Your previous plan is still shown.
firstPlan: Your first plan is being written. It usually takes a couple of minutes.

error.title: Could not load your coach
error.description: Check your connection and try again.

checkin.title: Tell your coach
checkin.placeholder: Sore calf, bad sleep, travelling Thursday to Sunday, felt great…
checkin.label: Note to your coach
checkin.hint: The plan is updated a moment after you send a note.
checkin.sent: Sent. Your coach will take it into account.

settings.title: Coach
settings.subtitle: Your AI running coach plans the next 14 days from your activities, sleep and notes, and updates the plan after every run and each morning.
settings.enabledHint: When on, your activities, sleep data and notes are sent to the AI model provider you choose below to write your plan.
settings.primaryGoal: Your main goal, in your own words
settings.primaryGoalPlaceholder: Run a sub-1:45 half marathon in spring and stay injury free.
settings.racesHint: A is the race the season builds toward, B is important, C is a training race.
settings.restHrHint: Leave blank to use your sleep data.
settings.thresholdPaceHint: About your one-hour race pace. Leave blank if unsure.
settings.experiencePlaceholder: Years running, usual weekly distance, past races and times…
settings.healthPlaceholder: Past injuries, niggles, medication that affects heart rate…
settings.preferencesPlaceholder: Trails or road, treadmill, strength training, sessions you like or hate…
settings.constraintsPlaceholder: Work travel, family schedule, morning-only runner, holidays…
settings.saved: Saved. Your coach will update the plan shortly.
settings.saveError: Could not save your coach settings.

model.title: AI model
model.subtitle: Choose which model writes your plan. With your own API key, usage is billed to your account with that provider.
model.modelHintAnthropic: Leave blank to use the server's default model.
model.modelHintOpenai: The model id exactly as your provider names it.
model.baseUrlHint: For example https://api.openai.com/v1, https://openrouter.ai/api/v1 or http://ollama:11434/v1. A server on your own network must be allowed by the administrator (SSRF_ALLOWED_HOSTS).
model.effortHint: Higher effort thinks longer and costs more.
model.noKeyHint: No key saved. Without one, Anthropic models use the server's key if the administrator set one up; local servers may not need a key.
model.keySavedHint: A key ending in …{hint} is saved. It is stored encrypted and never shown again.
model.replaceKey: Paste a new key to replace it
model.keyError: Could not update the API key.
model.checkHint: Save your settings first; the check uses what is saved.
